item.title: The Switch 2 Console Is Currently Cheaper Than Ever In The UK

description.p: Update: Amazon UK discounts the Switch 2.Earlier this year, Nintendo increased the price of the Switch 2 across multiple regions, including the UK. While the console launched at £395.99 back in June 2025, its price was raised to £419.99 thanks to global component shortages.Right now, however, you can pick up a Switch 2 for £354.99 from either Argos or Smyths in the UK. This is comfortably the cheapest price you can currently find for the console anywhere in the country, saving you a cool £65 – enough to add a game of your choice, if you wish.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Japanese Charts: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave Shifts Over 120,000 Physical Copies

description.p: Red hot debut.Famitsu has provided the latest look at the physical charts from Japan (albeit a little later than usual) and it's Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave that comes out on top this time with a total of 127,131 sales. A fine start for the latest entry in Nintendo's tactical RPG series!There are quite a few new entries this week, actually. Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter comes in at number 2 with 24,724 sales on Switch 2, while the PS5 version managed to shift 21,753 units. We also have Another Eden Begins on Switch 1 and 2, with the latter platform settling in at number 6 with 14,708 copies sold.Read the full article on nintendolife.com
